evidence_summary: Yanbu Cement's official 2025 Board report says the company expanded automation and AI applications in operational and administrative processes, used AI solutions for faster plant-data analysis and decision-making, and expanded AI-driven industrial automation applications supporting forecasting, proactive maintenance and plant efficiency.
source_locator: Board of Directors Report 2025, Operational Performance Summary, PDF pp.21-22
adoption_interpretation: Strong core-integration evidence by 2025; wording says the company 'continued' to expand AI, so true adoption is left-censored and must not be assigned to 2025 without earlier dated evidence.
notes: Core manufacturing use meets score-3 threshold. Separate customer-service AI and AI governance disclosures in the same report corroborate broad organizational integration.
